results.title: Rollouts V3: delivery verification and the tracking-quality envelope
results.summary: 50Hz executed-state humanoid trajectories for planner training: 1063 of 1392 candidate clips pass a three-part gate on jitter, motion preservation and phase lag. The gate reads joint angles only, so this report measures what it never did — world-frame limb deviation spans 45x across actions (0.029 to 1.314 m), but collapses to 0.033-0.128 m once the pelvis is aligned. The failure mode is accumulated root drift and it appears only in locomotion; relative limb motion holds everywhere. Ships with a contract checker that reports 1064 and 496 failures on the two builds this one replaces.

results.title: VAD_Cleaned_50Hz_Rollouts_V3: three-part gate and per-action executor assignment
results.summary: V3 assigns executors per action (SONIC for walk/kick, D6 GTrXL for the six upper-body/crouch actions) and gates rollouts on jitter, two-sided motion preservation, and phase lag; 1063/1392 clips (76.4%) pass. A pre-registered timing probe finds deceleration overshoot separates human-accepted kicks at 91% (permutation p=0.015) where 40 whole-clip metrics all fail.
